About.metaTitle: About Weiyon Industry — Taichung's 40-Year CNC Precision Machining Specialist
About.metaDescription: Weiyon Industry has been precision-machining metal parts in Taichung, Taiwan for 40+ years. Specializing in difficult materials (stainless, titanium, molybdenum, carbide) and one-stop integrated manufacturing (CNC turning/milling, EDM, sheet metal, surface treatment) for semiconductor, medical, aerospace, automotive, and precision machinery clients.
About.heroSubtitle:
A precision parts manufacturer in central Taiwan with 40+ years of experience.
From raw material to finished part — one-stop integrated manufacturing service.
About.story1: Weiyon Industry began as a small machining workshop in central Taiwan in the 1980s — when Taiwan's manufacturing sector was just taking off, and every process still relied on the senior machinist's hands-on judgment. Our origins reflect that era: starting with a drawing, a piece of stock, and a set of files.
About.story2: Over four decades, the industry transformed many times. CNC machines replaced conventional lathes; semiconductors, aerospace, and medical became new customer markets; materials expanded from stainless steel and aluminum to titanium and other difficult-to-machine alloys. We changed with it — from the nervousness of installing our first CNC mill to the confidence of running complex multi-axis paths today, every upgrade carried hours of relentless learning.
About.story3: But some things never changed. Daily machine checks before startup. A measurement record for every dimension. A batch number traceable on every piece of material. These seemingly old-fashioned disciplines are how we keep our promise on quality. When customers order, they receive more than parts — they receive 40 years of uncompromising commitment.
About.story4: Today's Weiyon Industry is built on the same conviction: get every part right. From one-off prototypes to volume production, from Taiwan-domestic to overseas orders, from traditional mechanical parts to advanced semiconductor components — no matter the size of the project, we treat every drawing as if it were our first.

About.valuesSubtitle: These values drive us forward and guide how we serve every customer
About.value1Desc: Every step — from material receipt and machining to inspection and shipment — has measurement records and traceability. Forty years of customer trust is built on uncompromising process discipline.
About.value2Desc: Customer needs often exceed the spec sheet — rush orders, special grades, difficult materials, design changes. Our flexibility keeps your project moving forward.
About.value3Desc: Transparent quoting, clear lead times, measurable quality. No exaggeration, no shortcuts. Senior technicians draw on decades of shop-floor experience to get every dimension right.
About.value4Desc: From hand tools to CNC controls to difficult-alloy machining, we keep adopting new technologies. Today's capability is yesterday's investment — tomorrow's competitiveness starts with today's.
